summary: Approves two agreements and an amendment with the Tennessee Department of Transportation to share the cost of road work on Cowan Street/Marine Drive and James Robertson Parkway, and lets the Mayor sign them. Metro's share is 50 percent of the $208 million Cowan Street/Marine Drive project ($104 million), and up to $119 million of the $185 million James Robertson Parkway project, paid in four installments each. It also backs early planning for a connection between the East Bank and the Ellington Parkway pedestrian bridge.
